integrity: Original mathematical proof and reproducible numerical checks are included; literature coverage and self-review are not independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic linear local invasion at the extinction equilibrium, no stochastic survival theorem. Fixed total per-patch export and unchanged positive patch extinction rates are required. The sharp bound is a nonattained infimum; several relevant source full texts were inaccessible.
title: Sharp corridor sensitivity of fixed-output metapopulation invasion
